i01.mp3.text: Not so very long from now, people stopped building things... and started growing them.

i02.mp3.text: A tiny seed could hold a whole design. Plant it, and the land would grow into its shape, block by block by block.

i03.mp3.text: Nature and machines grew into each other. Trees grew bark of carbon lattice, and leaves of solar film that drank the sunlight.
